about: Repeated complaints about the router, sorted by an agent from the skill ratings. scripts/friction-gate.mjs fails while any open entry has threshold or more reports. Sorting new ratings into entries is a reading-and-judging step for an agent, not text matching.

entries.summary: compositionPlan groups, marks and revealOnClick are boilerplate per entity kind, not designed for the content
entries.fixedBy: PR: compositionPlan marks, links, groups and revealOnClick come from the chosen view family's drawing grammar plus the reader's tasks, focus, provenance and optional relationshipEnds; designGaps names what the input cannot decide (e.g. more kinds than a reader can tell apart, link ends unknown). Primary form follows the chosen view. over-time no longer fires on interactive dynamics. Across 24 example use cases: groups 111 -> 1, time strips 15 -> 3, forms no longer 'map' for 19 of 24.
entries.note: The question-echo complaint was fixed separately (plan-question-echoes-concern).

entries.summary: An interactive or scroll-driven explainer (or composite view) ranks first for a short, static or one-screen page
entries.fixedBy: PR: static pages reject non-static forms; schedules need a timeline

entries.summary: Alternatives come back with relationshipToPrimary 'unclassified' because few substitute/complement relations are recorded
entries.fixedBy: PR: 26 more pairs reviewed (46 total) and 136 pairs labelled by two model families that agreed under two opposite wordings (rule matched review 11/11 on the reviewed pairs); alternatives carry source reviewed|drafted. Across the 24 example use cases: unclassified alternatives 41/47 -> 0/47. Of 324 co-occurring view pairs, 142 remain unrecorded and stay 'unclassified'.

entries.summary: The avoid list is empty whenever no representation fails a hard constraint, so a builder gets no 'do not use X because' guidance
entries.fixedBy: PR: avoid list ranks ruled-out views by how tempting they are for the question (shared structures, intents, tasks) and fills short lists with plausible weak fits (kind weak-fit, with the reason). Across the 24 example use cases: empty lists 4 -> 0, fewer than 3 entries 12 -> 0.
entries.note: Partly addressed 2026-10-23: static pages now list the rejected animated/scrolling forms with the reason. Also fixed in the same change: non-empty lists named the same five views in catalog order for every question.

entries.summary: project-schedule is ranked primary (or tied) for questions with no dates or durations
entries.fixedBy: PR: static pages reject non-static forms; schedules need a timeline

entries.summary: dynamics 'interactive' is read as over-time, adding a time strip and space-and-time check to non-temporal pages
entries.fixedBy: PR #128 (composition-plan-templated): over-time no longer fires on interactive dynamics. Rechecked 2026-10-26: an interactive, exploratory table use case lists space-and-time-shown-together only under quality.notApplicable.

entries.summary: The use case cannot say 'no external scripts' or 'must print', so d3 or Plot can be recommended for a page that forbids them
entries.fixedBy: constraints.scripts (any / self-contained / none) and constraints.print filter implementations by viewTimeScript, needsService and printable; print adds a hard check; no-JavaScript pages get no interactions (test/delivery-constraints.test.mjs)

entries.summary: requiredCapabilities reject a representation even when the surrounding surface supplies the capability
entries.fixedBy: heuristics/core.json surfaceSuppliedCapabilities (details-on-demand, evidence-inspector, linked-views, linked-selection, persistent-selection, filter, shared-filters, search) no longer reject a view on a page the reader can act on; primary.surfaceSupplies tells the page what to supply (test/surface-capabilities.test.mjs)

entries.summary: The density budget counts items, not nodes plus edges
entries.fixedBy: compositionPlan.densityBudget counts items plus scale.links for node-link and flow views (new optional scale.links); an unknown link count is a design gap (test/density-and-legend.test.mjs)

entries.summary: compositionPlan is per use case; there is no plan across the sections of one page
entries.fixedBy: use-case parts[] + src/page-plan.mjs buildPagePlan: one page plan (one screen budget, shared kind colours, one legend, cross-section gaps); the recommend CLI emits it for a use case with parts

entries.summary: compositionPlan.question repeats the whole concern paragraph instead of a short title
entries.fixedBy: PR: compositionPlan.title comes from a new optional use-case title (the caller shortens the concern; the router does not cut prose); question keeps the full concern; a concern over 12 words with no title is a designGap. All 24 examples have titles.

entries.summary: The use case cannot say results arrive in stages over 30-90 seconds (only realtime: true/false)
entries.fixedBy: constraints.arrival {mode at-once|staged|streaming, stages, typicalSeconds}: the router favours views whose objects keep their place and marks down scroll-driven and recorded views; the page plan adds progress-state and failure-state slots

entries.summary: No legend is planned when notation familiarity is novice
entries.fixedBy: compositionPlan.secondary gets a legend when audience.notationFamiliarity is novice or tasks include decode-notation (test/density-and-legend.test.mjs)

entries.summary: No representation for a single run's answer plus its receipt inside a card
entries.fixedBy: answer-receipt-card view (answer first, evidence with sources, receipt strip, failed run in the same layout) for embedded-widget and application media; completion-receipt and honest-unavailable-state interface patterns now fit embedded-widget and portfolio surfaces

entries.summary: No representation for interval/uncertainty displays or signed-effect matrices
entries.fixedBy: interval-plot and signed-effect-matrix views; use-case valueShape (magnitude|signed|interval) scores views that draw the range or the zero line and both directions (+3) over quantity views that hide them (-3)

entries.summary: No decision-table / ordered-guard representation, so ordered rules route to state-machine-view
entries.fixedBy: PR #135: informationStructure "rules" routes to the new decision-table representation (DMN hit policy FIRST), a substitute for directed-handoff-flow and bpmn-process; the real interview-kit refund rules route to it.

entries.summary: master-detail chosen for a list whose only detail is an external link
entries.fixedBy: New use-case itemDetail (in-page | link-out | none): link-out or none rejects views built around a detail pane (master-detail, schema-explorer, marked needsItemDetail) and routes to the new link-directory view; in-page marks the link list down (test/link-directory.test.mjs). The rating's per-viewport density ask was fixed by constraints.viewports.

entries.summary: node-link-graph and magnitude-flow ranked first for narrative pages
entries.fixedBy: New argument-page view (Minto pyramid: claim first, then one section per sub-claim with its evidence), static and interactive; views may name the media they suit (surfaceContext.medium scores +2), so a portfolio, report or document page that makes a case gets the argument page, while explanatoryFocus mechanism still gets an explainer (test/argument-page.test.mjs). The rating's tagger complaint was already fixed (understand/communicate/explanatory tag explanatory).

entries.summary: disposition demands a choice-justified line naming the router's primary even when the builder chose another view
entries.fixedBy: choice-justified:<what was built> answers the selection item; the record keeps chosenRepresentation (test/choice-alternative.test.mjs)

entries.summary: Use-case schema enums are not listed in SKILL.md, so agents guess values and get rejected
entries.fixedBy: docs/use-case-fields.md lists every use-case field and its allowed values, generated from the schema by scripts/use-case-fields.mjs; a test fails when it drifts; SKILL.md step 2 links it

entries.summary: The use-case schema has no viewport field
entries.fixedBy: constraints.viewports: the composition plan's density budget uses the declared screen that holds the fewest objects, lists each screen's budget, and flags mobile with no phone-width screen

entries.summary: Writing record refuses not_applicable on a default-format blocker when the user specifies different exact headings
entries.fixedBy: catalog marks default-layout blockers format; observe --user-format waives one as not_applicable with the user's words (test/writing-record.test.mjs)

entries.summary: A generic processing flow omitted the input categories and destination surfaces the user asked to see
entries.fixedBy: use case mustShow: each named part is on the page plan, in the generated-UI prompt, and a required shows:<part> disposition line that must say where it is visible (test/must-show.test.mjs)

entries.summary: writing_record declare --help does not show the NAME=yes|no:EVIDENCE grammar or that every fact is required
entries.fixedBy: declare --help shows --fact NAME=yes|no:EVIDENCE, says every fact is required, lists the fact names and the allowed media (scripts/writing_record.py)

entries.summary: The disposition command had no 'failed' status, so review findings were logged as skipped
constraints.mobile still planned a 1440x1000 screen
npm run recommend put npm's banner before the JSON, so redirected output did not parse
An unknown requiredCapabilities word rejected every representation with no hint
The emphasis state was 'selected' on static pages
The catalog had no bar, dot, line or scatter chart
The disposition checklist demanded interactive and drawing checks for static or text pages (46 lines for one Markdown page)
The disposition command wrote per-event log files into the router repository's working tree
entries.fixedBy: this change
